thread:
elaine: Hi team — Customer (fintech) asked for a POC plan for BYO-KMS + HSM-backed CMKs. Key asks: can we do customer-managed keys with an HSM, how does rotation work (30/90/annual windows), impact on pricing (hosted vs dedicated), and do we support offline key ceremony / escrow for regulated data? Need crisp answers to include in SOW and their security questionnaire.

sam: +1. Do they want CloudHSM (AWS/GCP) or a customer HSM appliance in their VPC? Also: do they need automated rotation or manual with approvals?

elaine: They prefer cloud HSM (AWS CloudHSM) for POC, but may bring an appliance later. Automation preference is manual rotation with audit logs for the first phase. Timeline: 2-week POC, then decide.

jess: For the POC I recommend: 1) Dedicated Redwood project in their VPC (Private mode) -> easiest to surface BYO-KMS. 2) Use a single CMK per environment + read-only audit account. 3) Rotation: we can support manual rotate via API + webhook notifications; automatic policies (cron) are possible but considered phase 2.

mohit: Security notes for questionnaire: we support CMEK with HSM-backed keys (customer-managed). Auditing: every key operation logs to the customer's CloudTrail (or equivalent) and to our audit logs if in Dedicated/Private mode. Key rotation flow: key versions / aliases are used; we never persist plaintext keys. For on-prem HSM scenarios, we support key importable wrapped keys but require an approved key-handling runbook.

sam: Pricing impact quick check: Hosted BYO-KMS (shared control plane) — minimal uplift but limited audit retention. Dedicated (reserved capacity in customer VPC) — add on: private control plane + KMS integration packaging fee. HSM passthrough + rotation support requires an "enterprise keying" add-on. I can draft numbers.

elaine: Can you put the SOW wording for the rotation window and rollback / fallback? They asked about immediate rollback if rotation fails mid-POC.

jess: Suggested SOW text (draft): ```We will integrate customer-managed HSM-backed CMKs. Rotation will be performed manually by authorized customer personnel via the agreed API endpoints. In the event of a failed rotation, Redwood will provide rollback to the previous key alias within the SLA window (4 hours in Dedicated; 8 hours in Hosted) and will run restore procedures per the agreed runbook.```

mohit: Addenda for security questionnaire: include that key material is either customer-held (BYO wrapping keys) or HSM-hosted in customer's CloudHSM; our role is limited to key aliasing and encrypted key blobs. Provide them the KMS integration guide + control mapping (SOC2/ISO) excerpt. I'll attach a short answer set.

opsbot: Upload: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/byo-kms-checklist.pdf (permissions: sales+sec).

sam: For the POC timeline and pricing: rough estimate for 2-week POC in Private mode + CloudHSM integration = $6k one-time setup + $2k/week infra (HSM + dedicated nodes) — ballpark. Enterprise keying add-on: $2k/mo. I will get a formal quote from finance.

elaine: Perfect. Two asks before I reply to customer: 1) mohit — please paste the security questionnaire answers inline (short bullets). 2) jess/sam — can you confirm the SOW snippet and the price band I can include?

mohit: Qs answers (short): - We support BYO CMKs with HSM backing (AWS CloudHSM or customer appliance). - Key material is never stored unencrypted in Redwood. - Rotation: supported via API; manual-first for POC; rollback supported within SLA. - Audit: key ops logged to customer CloudTrail + Redwood audit logs in Dedicated/Private. - Key import: supported only with customer-signed runbook and escrow approvals.

jess: SOW snippet is fine from my side. Add a line about a canary traffic policy during rotation: we route 10% of traffic to a fallback variant for 1h after rotation.

sam: Price band confirmed — I'm good with elaine sending ballpark; I'll follow up with formal quote.

elaine: Thanks all — I'll send this consolidated reply to the customer and attach the runbook link. If finance needs anything else, tag me. :thumbsup:

jess: One more tactical: for the POC we'll provide sample terraform snippet to wire the CloudHSM alias into Redwood. Example: ```resource "redwood_kms_integration" "demo" { provider = "aws" cloudhsm_cluster_id = "cl-abc123" key_alias = "poс-demo-1" mode = "BYO" }``` — send to customer as "example only".

mohit: I'll prep the short security appendix for the questionnaire and drop it in the thread later today.

elaine: Great — closing loop.
